explanation: L5/N241+ fires at a continuation point: a token whose left context has already committed the text to a unit that the following tokens must complete rather than start. Concretely it peaks on (a) the coordinator that closes the first member of a degree/quantity scale ('one or', 'three or', '30 or', 'more or', 'less or', 'fewer or', 'little or', 'several or', 'most or', 'sooner or', 'bigger or', 'higher or', and 'more and'), and on (b) the first sub-word piece of a rare multi-token word (' L'|ampard, ' Gr'|isham, ' inf'|ested, ' pred'|atory, ' und'|ifferentiated, ' D'|NF, '</div'|>). It stays near zero on coordinations of categorical alternatives ('red or blue', 'cats or dogs', 'yes or no' all ~0.0 while the same frame with 'one or two'/'sooner or later'/'bigger or smaller' reaches 2.0-2.6), on single-token content words after an article, and on 'than' comparisons.
